translations.web: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
translations.bsb: It is better to be lowly in spirit among the humble than to divide the spoil with the proud.
translations.kjv: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
translations.asv: Better it is to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, Than to divide the spoil with the proud.
